objective: Materializar el owner externo y persistente del Universal Job Worker sin violar el contrato single-owner. Agregar configuracion Supervisor dedicada para /app/tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_worker.sh con autostart/autorestart, EDARSA_ALLOW_PUSH=1 y logs separados; agregar activador idempotente que instale esa configuracion en /etc/supervisor/conf.d, haga reread/update y arranque solo el proceso universal; mantener edarsahub-mirror-sync separado y prohibido de spawn del universal worker. Agregar pruebas de contrato. No tocar Produccion ni debilitar Agent Guard.

actions.content:
[program:edarsahub-universal-worker]
command=/bin/bash /app/tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_worker.sh
directory=/app
autostart=true
autorestart=true
startsecs=3
startretries=20
stopsignal=TERM
stopwaitsecs=20
redirect_stderr=true
stdout_logfile=/var/log/supervisor/edarsahub-universal-worker.out.log
stdout_logfile_maxbytes=20MB
stdout_logfile_backups=3
environment=EDARSA_ALLOW_PUSH="1",UNIVERSAL_WORKER_INTAKE_SECONDS="10",UNIVERSAL_WORKER_RESULT_SECONDS="10",UNIVERSAL_WORKER_HEALTH_SECONDS="30",UNIVERSAL_WORKER_RECONCILE_SECONDS="30",UNIVERSAL_WORKER_DISPATCH_IDLE_SECONDS="2"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SRC=/app/tools/mirror_sync/supervisor/edarsahub-universal-worker.conf
DST=/etc/supervisor/conf.d/edarsahub-universal-worker.conf

test -r "$SRC" || { echo "ABORT=UNIVERSAL_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG_MISSING"; exit 2; }
install -m 0644 "$SRC" "$DST"
supervisorctl reread
supervisorctl update
supervisorctl start edarsahub-universal-worker 2>/dev/null || supervisorctl restart edarsahub-universal-worker
supervisorctl status edarsahub-universal-worker

from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CONF = ROOT / 'tools' / 'mirror_sync' / 'supervisor' / 'edarsahub-universal-worker.conf'
INSTALL = ROOT / 'tools' / 'mirror_sync' / 'supervisor' / 'install_universal_worker_supervisor.sh'
MIRROR = ROOT / 'tools' / 'mirror_sync' / 'mirror_sync_worker.sh'


def test_universal_worker_has_dedicated_supervisor_owner():
    text = CONF.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert '[program:edarsahub-universal-worker]' in text
    assert 'command=/bin/bash /app/tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_worker.sh' in text
    assert 'autostart=true' in text
    assert 'autorestart=true' in text
    assert 'EDARSA_ALLOW_PUSH=\"1\"' in text
    assert 'edarsahub-universal-worker.out.log' in text


def test_installer_is_idempotent_and_scoped_to_universal_worker():
    text = INSTALL.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'install -m 0644' in text
    assert 'supervisorctl reread' in text
    assert 'supervisorctl update' in text
    assert 'supervisorctl start edarsahub-universal-worker' in text
    assert 'supervisorctl restart edarsahub-universal-worker' in text
    assert 'edarsahub-mirror-sync' not in text


def test_mirror_remains_forbidden_from_spawning_universal_worker():
    text = MIRROR.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'UNIVERSAL_JOB_WORKER_START_BY_MIRROR=FORBIDDEN' in text
    assert 'UNIVERSAL_JOB_WORKER_OWNERSHIP=EXTERNAL' in text
